verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an official MCP server that connects a Lorikeet account to Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Codex and MintMCP. It exposes concrete capabilities including diagnosing tickets, auditing knowledge bases, building workflows, testing tools, running simulations and exploring the setup. A probe confirms the MCP server docs page is live and indexed in llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Lorikeet MCP server lets you interact with your Lorikeet account directly from Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Codex.
Connect to your Lorikeet account from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, and MintMCP using the Model Context Protocol.
Build workflows - create and iterate on workflows using natural language
official MCP server documented at https://docs.lorikeetcx.ai/mcp/mcp-server
